services.name: Hope Lake Campground
services.desc: To ensure availability, all reservations must be made using the Online Camping Reservation System prior to arrival. Bookings open on March 9th, 2026, at 9 a.m. Please note: A non-refundable booking fee per reservation will be charged at the time of booking. Cancellations will be allowed up to three working days before the date of camping. Campers can make changes regards length of stay or cancellations directly on their reservation confirmation email. For questions or concerns, campers are required to call the County Administration Office during regular business hours or email recreation@athabascacounty.com. Please do not call the After-Hours Emergency number, as this number is intended

services.name: Wildlife Control
services.desc: Alberta Environment regulations state that beavers may be hunted and trapped, without a license, during all seasons if: Beaver may also be trapped under a Fur Management License during an open season, or by someone who holds a Damage Control License (DCL). These licenses can be issued from any Fish and Wildlife Office in Alberta, and they authorize the removal of beavers outside of normal trapping seasons. It is against the law to disturb, or remove, a den or lodge without having a Damage Control License.
